name: Google reCAPTCHA v3
description: Spam protection for forms via Google reCAPTCHA v3 - score-based, invisible by default, admin-editable site/secret key and score threshold

setup.postInstallNote: Disabled by default. Requires a Google Cloud project with billing enabled and the reCAPTCHA Enterprise/legacy API set up (free tier is 10,000 assessments/month as of April 2026 - see Cloudflare Turnstile instead for an unlimited-free alternative with an identical verify() contract). A theme must call ServiceThemeBlocks::render('head', ['recaptcha' => ..., 'site' => $site]) to load the client script, which auto-executes and writes a token into a hidden #recaptcha-token field on every form (action 'submit'). A form handler calls RecaptchaConfig::verify($_POST['recaptcha-token'] ?? '') before processing.
